name: SPEED-Bench
intro: SPEED-Bench为推测解码提供语义多样性与真实服务吞吐两套数据划分及统一测量框架。其质量集从18个公开来源的11类数据中选出880条提示，吞吐集覆盖1k至32k输入长度、三种领域熵和最高512并发样本。
build_method: 公开数据聚合, 嵌入多样性筛选, 长度分桶
metric: Acceptance Rate, Acceptance Length, Output TPS, User TPS, Speedup
eval_feature: 推测解码, 生产推理引擎, 并发与长上下文
scale: 质量集880条；吞吐集5个长度桶×3类×512条
build_method_en: Public Data Aggregation, Embedding Diversity Selection, Length Bucketing
eval_feature_en: Speculative decoding, Production inference engines, Concurrency and long context
intro_en: SPEED-Bench pairs a semantically diverse qualitative split with realistic serving-throughput workloads and a unified speculative-decoding measurement framework. Its qualitative split selects 880 prompts across 11 categories from 18 public sources; the throughput split spans 1k-32k input lengths, three entropy groups, and up to 512 samples per group.
scale_en: 880 qualitative samples; 5 length buckets x 3 groups x 512 throughput samples
metric_en: Acceptance Rate, Acceptance Length, Output TPS, User TPS, Speedup
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SPEED-Bench arXiv:2604.09557 Sections 4-7 and Appendix B; official nvidia/SPEED-Bench dataset and measurement framework. SPEED-Bench has a qualitative split, a throughput split, and a unified measurement framework. The qualitative split aggregates 18 public sources into 11 categories, embeds candidates with text-embedding-3-large, and uses greedy selection plus local swaps to minimize pairwise similarity, retaining 80 prompts per category and 880 total. The throughput split draws real prompts from eight sources, groups them by low, mixed, or high entropy, and truncates or neutrally pads them into 1k, 2k, 8k, 16k, and 32k input-length buckets. Every bucket has 512 prompts per entropy group. The framework normalizes tokenization and prompt formatting outside SGLang, vLLM, and TensorRT-LLM, dispatches concurrent requests, and reports conditional acceptance rate, acceptance length, output TPS, user TPS, latency, and speedup.
